name: CUCKOO International (MAL) Berhad
overview: 2026年公司公告主要为与CKH的经常性关联交易（RRPTs）及公司治理、股息事项，未见新增业务、产能扩张、合约或业务出售的公告。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比下降19.8%至2.459亿MYR，净利润同比上升3.2%至2822万MYR。
overview_en: In 2026, the company's announcements mainly comprised recurrent related party transactions (RRPTs) with CKH, corporate governance and dividend matters; no announcements on new businesses, capacity expansion, contracts or business disposals were observed. In the latest quarter (30 June 2026), revenue fell 19.8% year-on-year to MYR245.9 million, while net profit rose 3.2% year-on-year to MYR28.2 million.

segments.name: 集团
segments.note: 今年公告主要涉及与CKH的经常性关联交易、股东批准及股息派发，未披露各业务板块的具体变动。

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 公告与CKH的经常性关联交易累计金额超过公司2024年12月31日经审计合并净资产的1%。
actions.text_en: Announced that the aggregate value of recurrent related party transactions with CKH exceeded 1% of the company's audited consolidated net assets as at 31 December 2024.

actions.text: 向股东发出通函，寻求追认及授权经常性关联交易。
actions.text_en: Issued a circular to shareholders seeking ratification and mandate for recurrent related party transactions.

actions.title: CKI - Notice of Book Closure
actions.text: 公告2025财年每股1.84仙的最终单层股息，除权日为2026年4月24日，派发日为2026年5月15日。
